successes.name: as-after-select
successes.text: FROM records AS old |> AS current |> SELECT current.id AS id |> WHERE id > 1 |> EXTEND id + 1 AS next |> SELECT next, id |> ORDER BY id

successes.name: set-snapshot
successes.text: FROM records AS old |> SET id = amount, amount = id |> SELECT id AS new_id, amount AS new_amount, old.id AS original_id, old.amount AS original_amount |> ORDER BY original_id

successes.name: drop-snapshot
successes.text: FROM records AS old |> DROP amount |> SELECT old.amount AS original_amount, id |> ORDER BY id

successes.name: rename-snapshot
successes.text: FROM records AS old |> RENAME amount AS renamed |> SELECT id, renamed, old.amount AS original_amount |> ORDER BY id

successes.name: as-current
successes.text: FROM records AS old |> SET amount = id |> AS current |> SELECT current.amount AS changed, current.id AS id |> ORDER BY id

successes.name: as-same-name
successes.text: FROM records AS old |> SET amount = id |> AS old |> SELECT old.amount AS changed, old.id AS id |> ORDER BY id

successes.name: as-quoted-case
successes.text: FROM records AS old |> SET amount = id |> AS `OLD` |> SELECT `old`.`AMOUNT` AS changed, `Old`.`ID` AS id |> ORDER BY id

successes.name: as-after-drop-rename
successes.text: FROM records AS old |> DROP amount |> RENAME id AS key |> AS current |> SELECT current.key AS key |> ORDER BY key

successes.name: sql-alias-projection
successes.text: SELECT old.amount AS original_amount, old.id AS id FROM records AS old ORDER BY id

successes.name: as-current-star
successes.text: FROM records AS old |> DROP amount |> RENAME id AS key |> AS current |> SELECT * |> ORDER BY key

successes.name: as-empty
successes.text: FROM records AS old |> SET amount = id |> AS current |> WHERE current.id > 100 |> SELECT current.amount AS changed, current.id AS id |> ORDER BY id
